Mali.summary: BAMAKO and Algiers talk again. Ambassadors have returned, diplomatic borders are reopening and a visit by General Assimi Goïta to Algeria is announced. Good!

Mali.title: GAO: 234 trainees complete their Inter-Arms Certificate (CIA) training
Mali.summary: The Gao Mixed Instruction Center hosted, on Wednesday, October 7, 2026, the ceremony of end of training of the first wave of the Joint Certificate (CIA), session 2025, started on July 10, 2026. For three months, 234 trainees from the Defence and Security Forces underwent training to strengthen their military knowledge and skills . At the end of this course, they are now able to assume the functions of deputy non-commissioned officer to the section head.

Mali.title: DIRECTORATE OF THE ARMED FORCES COMMISSARIAT: The Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces on an official visit
Mali.summary: The Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces (CEMGA), Major General Elisée Jean DAO, visited the Directorate of the Commissariat of the Armed Forces (DCA), formerly Military Headquarters, on Friday, October 9, 2026. This visit is a continuation of the authority visits made by the CMSA to the various service directorates of the Malian Armed Forces since his appointment as head of the institution in May .

Mali.title: Mali: In Kidal, soldiers outnumber locals
Mali.summary: Mali: in Kidal, the soldiers outnumber the inhabitants Three days after their return to Kidal, the Malian soldiers and their Russian partners of the Africa Corps secure the city and its surroundings. The army conducts daily airstrikes in the area but has not yet continued its ground advance The separatists of the Azawad Liberation Front (Fla) and the jihadists of the Support Group for Islam and Muslims (Jnim), linked to al-Qaeda, were forced to withdraw before the arrival of the army in Kidal.

Mali.title: In Mali, the recapture of the city of Kidal offers a symbolic victory to the junta and its Russian ally
Mali.summary: In Mali, the recapture of the city of Kidal offers a symbolic victory to the junta and its DECRYPTING Russian ally - The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by Russian mercenaries and Tuareg loyalists, have taken over this rebel-held city since a general offensive in April. Skip adWinners didn't repeat the mistake . On November 14, 2023, during the first conquest of Kidal by the Malian army with the support of Wagner, the Russian mercenaries, enlisted by the ruling junta, had raised their black flag with a death's head.

Mali.title: Resumption of Kidal: place for the security and effective return of state services
Mali.summary: The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) consolidated their presence in Kidal on 6 October 2026, at the end of military operations carried out as part of Operation Dougoukoloko, with the support of their Russian partners. This breakthrough is an important step . The sustainable security of the city, the protection of the population and the effective return of state services are now major issues.

Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Gao: Trial of nine (9) criminal cases involving 11 defendants
Mali.summary: Gao, 9 October (AMAP) The first session of the criminal chamber of the Gao High Court ended on 8 October 2026 in the City of Askias, noted AMAP . Started on October 6, this series of hearings aimed to deal with 9 major criminal cases involving a total of 11 defendants including the nature of the cases examined and all judged at the very first hearing of the criminal chamber of the Gao High Court, namely 2 murders, 3 pedophilia, 2 fatal strokes, 1 rape and 1 murder During these hearings, the Criminal Chamber of the Gao TGI pronounced sanctions commensurate with the criminal offences committed.

Mali.title: Fama takeover of Kidal: Choguel Maiga's reaction
Mali.summary: Capture of Kidal by the Fama: Choguel Maiga Kidal's reaction is no longer in the hands of the terrorists. This strategic town in northern Mali was recaptured by the Malian Armed Forces (Fama) on October 6, after a vast military offensive carried out with the support of the Russian partners of Africorps. From the prison of Koulikoro, the former Malian Prime Minister Choguel Maiga congratulated the FAMa for their shine .

Mali.title: Mali: "The army has its place in Kidal but regaining it does not end the violence", for the opposition coalition CFR
Mali.summary: In Mali, the army and its Russian partners in the Africa Corps retook Kidal in the north on 6 October from the Fla separatists and the Jnim jihadists, who had controlled it for more than five months. A victory for the transitional authorities who intend to restore the authority of the State throughout the territory . The CFR, a coalition of opponents in exile, also defends national sovereignty throughout the territory but advocates dialogue with armed groups.

Mali.title: Talhandak, Kidal and Tessalit: Terrorist Positions Targeted and Accurately Addressed
Mali.summary: The announcement was made on October 7, 2026 by the General Staff of the Armed Forces which indicates that in the continuity of the offensive launched in the East Theater, the air-land operations conducted today made it possible to precisely target several positions of the armed terrorist groups . On the ground, according to the security source, the responsiveness of the units made it possible to obtain convincing results, in particular in Talhandak, where terrorist elements who had sheltered under a canopy were neutralized and their vehicle completely destroyed .

Mali.title: Mali: "The army has its place in Kidal but regaining it does not end the violence", for the opposition coalition CFR
Mali.summary: Mali: "The army has its place in Kidal but reconquering it does not end the violence", for the opposition coalition CFR In Mali, the army and its Russian partners of the Africa Corps took over Kidal, in the North, from the Fla separatists and the Jnim jihadists, who had controlled it for more than five months. A victory for the transitional authorities who intend to restore the authority of the State throughout the territory .

Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: FAMa precision strikes against terrorist bases in San, Takalot and Talhandak
Mali.summary: The General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the national opinion that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, are continuing the permanent operations of surveillance, control and security of the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko In the continuation of the offensive launched in the Eastern Theater, the air-land operations conducted on Thursday, October 8, 2026 made it possible to target several positions of the armed terrorist groups.

Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Takalot, Talhandak and San: Several positions of terrorist groups struck down
Mali.summary: Bamako, October 9 (AMAP)– The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) destroyed a vehicle containing war materiel northeast of Takalot and hit a major logistics point in the Talhandak area, as well as a base housing terrorist elements northeast of San, during air-land operations conducted Thursday, October 8 as part of Operation Dougoukoloko, according to the General Staff of the Armed Forces .

Mali.title: Month of Solidarity: President Assimi GOÏTA with the Dean of Bamako The inhabitants of the Troukabougou sector of Djicoroni Para, in Commune IV of the District of Bamako, woke up this Thursday, October 8, 2026 under an impressive security device.
Mali.summary: Very early in the morning, the staking of the elements of the Security Forces announced that this district would welcome a distinguished host, including the President of the Transition, Army General Assimi Goïta, who sacrificed to a well-established tradition of the Month of Solidarity and the Fight against Exclusion, that is to say the visit of the highest authorities to the elderly It was in this spirit that the Head of State went to the bedside of the Dean of Bamako, Namory Keita.

Mali.title: In Mali, why the takeover of Kidal is a bitter-tasting victory for the junta
Mali.summary: It had been several days since a scent of reconquest floated in the air. On the morning of Tuesday, October 6, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by Russian elements of Africa Corps, retook the city of Kidal In a statement dated the same day, the Malian military authorities announced that they had engaged in "large-scale air-land operations in the Kidal region" with a view to "neutralizing armed terrorist groups" and "destroying their sanctuaries".

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso: The export of millet, maize and sorghum flour suspended until further notice
Burkina Faso.summary: The Burkinabe government suspends, until further notice, the export of millet, maize and sorghum flour, as well as their derivatives, throughout the national territory. The measure aims to ensure the availability of these products on the internal market and to improve their accessibility to consumers . In a press release dated 9 October 2026, the Ministry of Industry, Trade and Handicrafts informed economic operators and populations of this decision.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso: The junta tries to relax with the Sunnis
Burkina Faso.summary: The release this Sunday, October 4, 2026, of approximately 80 supporters of Imam Mohamed Kindo is a political signal. Arrested at the end of May after a banned demonstration, shaved, and sent for training at the police camp, they are returning to their families. With video evidence, the junta is carefully staging a display of appeasement.

Burkina Faso.title: No to family war!
Burkina Faso.summary: We have VDPs on the battlefield against the forces of evil, but who are the VDPs in our families and where are they? We have been at war against terrorism for a decade but in our families, we shoot each other with live ammunition and at close range, among blood brothers, sometimes in deafening silence, sometimes with an unprecedented noise that attracts crowds .

Burkina Faso.title: ‎ Burkina Faso: The export of millet, maize and sorghum flour suspended until further notice
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkina Faso: The export of millet, maize and sorghum flour suspended until further notice The export of cereal flour, including millet, maize and sorghum, as well as their derivatives, is suspended throughout the national territory until further notice. The information comes from a press release from the Minister of Trade, Industry and Handicrafts dated October 9, 2026 .

Burkina Faso.title: Terrorists’ Illicit Funding Streams Converge
Burkina Faso.summary: Jama’at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin (JNIM) amasses an estimated $100 million a year through a web of illicit activities that illustrates the way terrorism, organized crime and public corruption are connected. “Make no mistake, today illicit economies in the Sahel and West Africa are interlinked criminalities across borders,” David M. Luna, executive director of the International Coalition Against Illicit Economies (ICAIE), told a recent webinar hosted by the Nigerian Financial Intelligence Unit (NFIU).

Niger.title: Court remands Nigerien man in Abuja for alleged supply of AK-47 ammunition for terrorism
Niger.summary: The Federal High Court in Abuja on Friday remanded a Nigerien national, Muhammad Ibrahim, over charges of transporting 170 rounds of AK-47 ammunition for terrorist activities in Katsina State. Judge Salim Ibrahim ordered that Mr Ibrahim be remanded at the Kuje Correctional Centre in Abuja after he pleaded not guilty to four counts, including terrorism and fraudulent acquisition of a Nigerian identification number – the National Identity Number (NIN).

Niger.title: Niger: Niger's Junta Tightens Its Grip On Free Expression
Niger.summary: Lawyer Tried on Bogus Charges; Journalist Feared Forcibly Disappeared A lawyer in Niger faces prosecution over comments about the army on social media while a prominent journalist and critic of the country's military junta is being held in secret, with authorities refusing to identify his alleged offense. These cases together highlight a broadening crackdown in Niger, where the space for free expression is shrinking by the day.

Mali.title: When the home becomes a place of death: the series of domestic violence in Mali
Mali.summary: The death of Racky Diaby, a young Malian presented in several recent publications as having been killed by her husband by firearms, brings to the fore a reality that is not new in Mali. Over the years, several women have lost their lives in their own homes, victims of violence committed by their spouses . Behind every case, there is a woman, a family and the same question: what to do when violence settles in a couple before it becomes irreversible?

Mali.title: Video said to show Mali army in Kidal after retaking city
Mali.summary: Recently published video is said to show Mali’s armed forces in Kidal after retaking the strategic northern city from Tuareg separatists. It would be a major symbolic gain for Mali’s military government, which lost the city to separatists six months ago.

Mali.title: What Russia’s Africa Corps Is Actually Doing in Mali
Mali.summary: - African Arguments, 7 October 2026 On September 14, 2026, more than 900 fuel tankers entered Bamako under military escort, the Malian government announced.

Mali.title: KIDAL: The FAMa consolidate their operational system in the city
Mali.summary: As part of the large-scale offensive conducted in the Eastern Theater, as part of Operation DOUGOUKOLOKO, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) on Wednesday, October 7, 2026, consolidated their operational system in the city of KIDAL This operation comes following a campaign of intense airstrikes and several air-land operations carried out over the last few days, which have made it possible to neutralize several elements belonging to the FLA-JNIM terrorist coalition, while dealing significant blows, in depth, to their logistical capacities and their means of action.

Mali.title: Drama in Faladié: A young bride shot dead, her husband taken into custody
Mali.summary: DRAMA IN FALADIÉ: A YOUNG BRIDE SHOT DEAD, HER HUSBAND ARRESTED barely a few days after her wedding, HARKIA was found dead in the marital chamber. A firearm was reportedly discovered at the home of her husband, who was taken into custody. The tragedy occurred on the night of Tuesday, October 6 to Wednesday, October 7, 2026 at about 3 a.m., in Faladié .

Mali.title: Malian army recaptures Kidal with Russian support.. 'Liberation of Azawad' vows to continue fighting
Mali.summary: The Malian army regained control of the strategic city of Kidal in the north of the country, after the withdrawal of the Front for the Liberation of Azawad from it following extensive air and ground operations carried out by the Malian forces with the support of the Russian "African Legion", in a development that represents an important symbolic gain for the military government in Bamako, but it does not seem decisive for the course of the ongoing conflict in the north of the country.

Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: Malian forces target supply networks in Kidal
Mali.summary: As part of Operation Dougoukoloko, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their allies, have implemented several strategies to reduce the operational capabilities of opposing armed groups During the preparatory operations for the assault on Kidal, an active reconnaissance made it possible to identify several rear bases, storage facilities and fuel depots used by the armed groups.

Mali.title: Mali: after the takeover of Kidal, the FAMa launch a new operation
Mali.summary: The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by the Russian Africa Corps, are conducting a sweep operation in southern Kidal, after the city was retaken on October 6. According to the Africa Corps, armed combatants fled in a hurry as troops approached. Indeed, on October 6, the army entered the city of Kidal around 1 p.m., according to Malian security sources .

Mali.title: Me Mountaga Tall: we don't talk about it anymore?
Mali.summary: Five months after his alleged abduction, the silence around the fate of Me Mountaga Tall seems to settle. A situation that worries relatives, relatives and even human rights organizations. The name of Me Mountaga Tall, once very present in the debate and on social networks, seems to be gradually disappearing from the news.

Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: Allied Mali-Russian forces thwart terrorist ambushes on the outskirts of Kidal
Mali.summary: During their advance on Kidal, the joint units of Mali and Russia neutralized several ambush threats during reconnaissance patrols on the outskirts of the city. Several ambush locations were thus identified by the reconnaissance teams . According to the information gathered, the mission assigned to these terrorist groups was to delay the advance of the allied forces while the main forces of the terrorist coalition formed by the Fla (Frame for the Liberation of Azawad) and the JNIM (Group for the Support of Islam and Muslims) withdrew from Kidal.

Mali.title: Mali: A return in trompe-l'oeil of the Fama in Kidal?
Mali.summary: The Malian army and its Africa Corps allies announced that they had reinvested Kidal on Tuesday, October 6, 2026. The Fla (Azawad Liberation Front) and the Jnim (Support Group for Islam and Muslims) claim a tactical withdrawal to preserve the populations. Some think that this return bears the mark of Algiers.

Mali.title: Kéniéba: An international network for money laundering and trafficking in cultural property dismantled
Mali.summary: The Keniéba Gendarmerie Brigade recently arrested a young man from Faléa, Kéniéba commune, Kayes region, involved in an alleged international network of money laundering and trafficking in cultural property. The operation led to the seizure of 3 carved doors of great heritage value, which were allegedly stolen from Dékon, in the Bandiagara region, and intended for export to the West Source: L’Indicateur du Renouveau, Mali

Mali.title: Me Mountaga Tall: we don't talk about it anymore?
Mali.summary: Five months after his alleged abduction, the silence around the fate of Me Mountaga Tall seems to settle. A situation that worries relatives, relatives and even human rights organizations. The name of Me Mountaga Tall, once very present in the debate and on social networks, seems to be gradually disappearing from the news .

Mali.title: Military justice: Bamako Court sentences military and civilians for arms trafficking
Mali.summary: Military justice: The Court of Bamako convicts military and civilians for arms trafficking The Military Court of Bamako held, on Tuesday, October 6, 2026, its ordinary correctional hearing, presided over by Magistrate Assama Dolo. Five cases were on the docket, involving several military and civilian personnel for serious acts related to weapons and military discipline .

Mali.title: Mali: 900 Tankers Under Escort - What Africa Corps Actually Does in Mali
Mali.summary: On September 14, 2026, more than 900 fuel tankers entered Bamako under military escort, the Malian government announced. The figure sounds like a victory: the capital got its fuel. But the very need to herd 900 tankers into a single protected convoy is not a story about victory -- it is a story about how vulnerable the ordinary roads have become, the same roads through which Mali imports 95% of its fuel.

Mali.title: Kidal: Colonel Attaher Maiga and his men at the heart of the FAMa's takeover and securing of the city
Mali.summary: Kidal: Colonel Attaher Maïga, from the "red beret" to the command of the FAMa to consolidate the presence of the Malian State The truth of the weapons and the terrain prevailed over the opposing propaganda: Kidal is definitively and fully released, secured and reinstated in the bosom of the Republic of Mali . Colonel Attaher Maiga In the aftermath of this decisive step taken by the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), it is a poignant testimony, full of assurance, authority and patriotism, delivered by Colonel Attaher A.

Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: the FAMa intensify their air-land operations in the Talhandak, Kidal and Tessalit sectors
Mali.summary: Bamako, 7 October 2026 – The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) are resolutely continuing their missions to monitor, control and secure the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko According to the information provided by the General Staff of the Armed Forces, several aero-terrestrial actions were carried out on Wednesday, October 7, 2026 in different sectors of the Eastern Theater, in particular in the Talhandak areas, north of Kidal and in the Tessalit region .

Mali.title: Militant spillover from Mali raises mining-related security risks in Guinea
Mali.summary: Executive summary Guinea has remained largely insulated from the militant violence affecting neighboring Mali. However, the security environment along the Mali-Guinea border has become increasingly fragile as the al-Qaeda-affiliated Jama’at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin (JNIM) has expanded and entrenched its presence across southern Mali. This expansion has brought militant activity closer to Guinea’s eastern border areas, where major industrial and artisanal mining sites are located.

Burkina Faso.title: Road safety: 700 vehicles impounded in one morning in Ouagadougou
Burkina Faso.summary: This Thursday, October 8, 2026, the Ouagadougou municipal police conducted a vast control operation on the roads of the capital. Between 6:00 am and 10:00 am, this descent focused on compliance with the mandatory helmet resulted in the impoundment of 700 two-wheeled vehicles and three tricycles . After a two-year nationwide awareness-raising period, municipal and security authorities have resolutely shifted to a phase of repression.

Niger.title: Niger: France expels two intelligence agents, one suspected of monitoring opponents
Niger.summary: Tensions between France and Niger have been building since 2023. France has expelled two agents of the Nigerien intelligence services, reveals Le Monde on October 8, citing a French diplomatic source and a Nigerien source. One of the expelled officers was suspected of carrying out surveillance activities targeting opponents of the Niamey authorities present on French soil .

Niger.title: No ransom paid for release of abducted corps members, says Imo CP
Niger.summary: The Imo State Commissioner of Police, Audu Bosso, has said he is not aware of any ransom payment for the release of 20 prospective National Youth Service Corps members and a civilian abducted along the Owerri-Onitsha Road. The victims, who were abducted on October 1, 2026, were rescued from the Amokohia Uwe Forest in the Owerri West Local Government Area of the state after a coordinated operation by security agencies.

Niger.title: PANDEF mourns victims of Ondo Air Force crash, seeks probe
Niger.summary: By Henry Umoru ABUJA — The Pan Niger Delta Forum (PANDEF), the apex socio-political body of the South-South geopolitical zone, has mourned the victims of the Nigerian Air Force (NAF) aircraft crash in the Igbokoda area of Ilaje Local Government Area of Ondo State. PANDEF also called for a thorough and comprehensive investigation to determine the circumstances that may have contributed to the crash and similar aviation tragedies.

Niger.title: The Nigerien Armed Forces sensitized on the general mobilization
Niger.summary: Niamey, 08 Oct(ANP)- The Chief of Staff of the Armed Forces, Brigadier General Mamane Sani KIAOU chaired, on Wednesday, October 07, 2026 at the Palais des Congrès in Niamey, an exchange meeting with the Commission responsible for the organization, preparation and monitoring of the implementation of the General Mobilization (COMOG) .

Niger.title: Diffa/Goudoumaria: 250 t of millet for targeted free distribution in 104 villages
Niger.summary: Le Sahel.org

significant_events.summary: Mali's army, supported by Russian paramilitary forces, has re-entered the northern town of Kidal, forcing the Tuareg separatists to withdraw from the strategic hold, in a symbolic boost for the country's military government and its Russian allies. It said the withdrawal took place without direct fighting.

Mali.title: Mali: what changes the takeover of Kidal by the army?
Mali.summary: By retaking the strategic town of Kidal in northern Mali on Tuesday, the Malian army supported by the Russian Africa Corps paramilitaries achieved a highly symbolic success, almost six months after losing control to the Tuareg separatists. But it is a ghost town deserted by its inhabitants that the central Malian state has recovered without fighting, while Bamako struggles to control its territory in this vast desert country plagued by a jihadist insurgency and the independence claims of Tuareg groups.

Mali.title: The Malian army recaptures the strategic city of Kidal from the Tuareg rebels.. The military announces the implementation of large-scale air and ground operations to neutralize armed groups and destroy their strongholds.. and the withdrawal of the Front for the Liberation of Azawad from the city as the forces advance
Mali.summary: In a landmark military development in northern Mali, the Malian army announced its entry into the strategic city of Kidal, after the fighters of the Tuareg Liberation Front of Azawad withdrew from the city in conjunction with the advance of government forces, in a move that returns the city to army control after months of separatist control.

Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Talhandak, Kidal and Tessalit: FAMa destroy positions of armed terrorist groups
Mali.summary: Bamako, October 7 (AMAP)– The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, destroyed several positions of armed terrorist groups as part of Operation Dougoukoloko on Wednesday by conducting air-land operations in Talhandak, Kidal and Tessalit, the General Staff of the Armed Forces announced. In the Eastern Theater, the operations made it possible to neutralize, in Talhandak, terrorist elements .

Mali.title: 900 Tankers Under Escort: What Africa Corps Actually Does in Mali
Mali.summary: On September 14, 2026, more than 900 fuel tankers entered Bamako under military escort, the Malian government announced. The figure sounds like a victory: the capital got its fuel. But the very need to herd 900 tankers into a single protected convoy is not a story about victory — it is a story about how vulnerable the ordinary roads have become, the same roads through which Mali imports 95% of its fuel.

Mali.title: Eastern Theatre: Surgical FAMa offensive, destroyed vehicles and destroyed terrorist retreats
Mali.summary: Eastern Theatre: Surgical offensive of the FAMa, destroyed vehicles and destroyed terrorist retreats Operation Dougoukoloko continues on the Eastern Front, according to an official statement from the General Staff of the Armed Forces. The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, conducted new air-land operations on Wednesday, October 7, 2026 .

Mali.title: Reclaiming Kidal: A Strategic Turning Point for Security and National Sovereignty
Mali.summary: Recapture of the city of Kidal: THE INTREPID FAMAS CONSOLIDATE THEIR PRESENCE IN KIDAL AFTER A VAST AERO-TERRESTRIAL OPERATION They spoke of the city of Kidal on their media, as an impregnable city, inaccessible or even the indestructible strongholds of their terrorist acolytes. However, the warning had been raised by the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) and their Russian allies of Africa Corps, during the Battle of Anefif .

Mali.title: GAO: release of the first promotion of Cutting and Sewing of the Training Center of the Branch of the Social Service of the Armed Forces
Mali.summary: The graduation ceremony of the first training promotion in Cutting and Sewing of the Training Center of the Branch of the Social Service of the Armed Forces of Military Region No.1 was held on Saturday, October 3, 2026, in the premises of the said Center, at the Firhoun Ag Alinçar camp in Gao . The ceremony took place in the presence of the Zone Commander, Colonel Ibrahim SAMASSA, representatives of the directors of services of the security forces as well as the Prefect of Gao, Benenan MOUNKORO, alongside several guests and personalities from the region.

Mali.title: Kidal taken over by the Malian army, which will change on the Senegalese border
Mali.summary: The takeover of Kidal by the Malian army and its allies could intensify security tensions in eastern Senegal, affecting not only regional security but also commercial activities between Dakar and Bamako, essential for the national economy . The Malian Armed Forces and their Russian allies from Africa Corps retook Kidal, after the departure of the Azawad Liberation Front.

Mali.title: Malians aspire to return to the city of Kidal
Mali.summary: According to the General Staff of the Armed Forces of Mali, as early as Monday, October 5, "major airstrikes were carried out by the air force to reduce enemy positions. This favoured the recapture of the city of Kidal the next day by the FAMa, without a fight". In the nearby town of Gao, thousands of Kidal residents, such as teacher Almoustapha Maiga, found refuge .

Mali.title: Kidal, what challenges for sustainable stability?
Mali.summary: The recapture of Kidal by the Malian army on Tuesday, October 6, 2026, revived the debate on the conditions for a lasting return to peace in the region. For some Malians, the priority is to strengthen the security system. Others advocate for dialogue and the restoration of basic social services in order to consolidate this presence.

Mali.title: THE TITLES OF OCTOBER 7, 2026
Mali.summary: - After the recapture of Kidal by the army, the Malians are divided between the solutions to stabilize the region. Some propose strengthening the military presence on the ground, but others opt for dialogue. - The city of Macina has been plunged into darkness for more than nine months.

Mali.title: MILITARY COURT OF BAMAKO: five cases on the list of the correctional hearing
Mali.summary: The Military Court of Bamako held, on Tuesday, October 6, 2026, at its headquarters, its ordinary correctional hearing. In total, five (05) cases were on the list, involving several military and civilians. The hearing was presided over by Magistrate Assama DOLO, assisted by his fellow magistrates .

Mali.title: Article reserved for Sahel subscribers. Mali: in Kidal, taken over by the army, "the game of cat and mouse" continues International mail

Mali.title: Sudan: 1,770 people displaced in Blue Nile State, according to IOM
Mali.summary: Bamako, Oct. 7 (AMAP) Some 1,770 people from 354 households were displaced Monday from several villages in southern Sudan's Blue Nile State due to the deteriorating security situation, the International Organization for Migration (IOM) said Tuesday. According to IOM, the displacements were recorded in several villages in the locality of Wad al-Mahi .

Mali.title: In Mali, the takeover of Kidal "consolidates" the Transition
Mali.summary: In Mali, the army and its Russian partners of the Africa Corps reinvested Tuesday, October 6, the city of Kidal, in the north of the country, less than six months after being driven out by the separatists of the Fla and their jihadist allies of the Jnim, linked to al-Qaeda. This prestigious victory was achieved without even having to fight, as the armed groups withdrew before the arrival of the army .

Mali.title: Mali: after the takeover of Kidal, the challenges facing the Malian army
Mali.summary: Kidal comes back under the control of the Malian army for the second time in less than three years. The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) entered this city in northern Mali on Tuesday, October 6, 2026, five months and eleven days after it was taken, on April 25, by the Azawad Liberation Front (Fla) Allied with the Support Group for Islam and Muslims (Jnim), the independence movement had snatched it from Bamako less than three years after the first resumption of November 2023.

Mali.title: FAMa enter Kidal after Fla withdrawal
Mali.summary: The Malian Armed Forces entered Kidal on Tuesday, October 6, five months after leaving the city. In a statement read on national television, government spokesman Brigadier General Issa Ousmane Coulibaly announced that national forces had regained control of this northern regional capital According to the government, the operation mobilized ground and air assets with the support of Russian partners.

Mali.title: "Kidal is and will remain Malian": Choguel Kokalla Maïga's strong tribute to the memory of General Sadio Camara and the bravery of the FAMa
Mali.summary: Message from former Prime Minister Choguel Kokalla MAÏGA, following the consolidation of the military assets of the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) in Kidal As part of Operation DOUGOUKOLOKO, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) and their Russian partners have launched, since last weekend, a major air-land operation in the Kidal region Five months after the treacherous terrorist attacks of April 25, 2026, which took the life of General Sadio Camara, Minister of State, Minister of Defense and Veterans Affairs, these operations aimed to track down and neutralize the remnants of terrorist armed groups operating throughout the…

Mali.title: Kidal: The end of recess ​The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their foreign partners, signed their return to the city of Kidal yesterday. The large-scale air-land operations they initiated made it possible to track down and neutralize the terrorist groups that were sowing disorder and desolation in the locality.
Mali.summary: FAMa elements operating in the locality In the wake of this overwhelming victory, the General Staff of the Armed Forces invites the people of Kidal to calm down, to be vigilant and to continue their precious collaboration with the Defence and Security Forces. Large-scale operations have been carried out for a few days in the Kidal Region Determined to regain control of this strategic city, the Malian Army has launched an unprecedented offensive aimed at putting pressure on the armed terrorist groups operating in the region.

Mali.title: Mali Army Retakes Kidal With Russian Support
Mali.summary: Mali's army, backed by Russian paramilitary forces, has retaken the northern town of Kidal after Tuareg separatists announced a "strategic and controlled withdrawal" from the area. The Azawad Liberation Front said its forces withdrew without direct fighting, attributing the move to what it described as the disproportionate use of air power by Russia's Africa Corps.

Mali.title: Mali: Junta Forces Retake Strategic Town of Kidal
Mali.summary: Mali's military regained control of the strategic town of Kidal after forcing Tuareg separatists and al-Qaeda-linked jihadists to withdraw following an offensive backed by Russia's Africa Corps. Mali's army, supported by Russian paramilitary forces, has re-entered the northern town of Kidal, forcing the Tuareg separatists to withdraw from the strategic hold, in a symbolic boost for the country's military government and its Russian allies.

Mali.title: The Malian army has regained possession of Kidal
Mali.summary: After airstrikes in recent days in the Kidal region, an impressive land convoy from Gao, then Anefis, entered the Tuareg rebel stronghold on Tuesday afternoon, without encountering resistance. The Azawad Liberation Front (Fla), which had held the city since April 26, withdrew in front of the advance of the column .

Mali.title: Mali: in Kidal, "the army recovered territory, it did not beat its opponent"
Mali.summary: In Mali, the junta of General Goïta managed yesterday Tuesday to recapture the city of Kidal, which it had lost six months ago to the Tuareg rebels of the Fla, the Azawad Liberation Front. The Malian Armed Forces and their Russian allies entered the large city in the far north of the country without a fight yesterday afternoon. Is this the end of the war?

Mali.title: Mali: Junta forces retake strategic town of Kidal
Mali.summary: Mali's army, supported by Russian paramilitary forces, has re-entered the northern town of Kidal, forcing the Tuareg separatists to withdraw from the strategic hold, in a symbolic boost for the country's military government and its Russian allies. The Tuareg separatist Azawad Liberation Front (FLA) said in a statement it had "decided to carry out a strategic and controlled withdrawal of its forces from the town of Kidal." It said the withdrawal took place without direct fighting.

Mali.title: Kidal: the Malian army regains control of the city
Mali.summary: The Malian army regained control of Kidal, in northern Mali, on Tuesday, October 6. The Malian Armed Forces entered the city without resistance. This return comes more than five months after the capture of Kidal by the Azawad Liberation Front (Fla), allied to the Group for the Support of Islam and Muslims (JNIM) Several security sources confirm this entry of the Fama into Kidal.

Mali.title: Mali’s army says it has taken Kidal from Tuareg rebels, with Russia’s help
Mali.summary: Mali’s armed forces have entered the strategic northern city of Kidal, five months after separatist rebels seized it, following an air and ground campaign backed by Russia’s Africa Corps. In a statement carried by state television on Tuesday, Mali’s transitional government said troops had “consolidated their positions” in the city, “supported by their Russian partners”.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso Orders Major Curriculum Overhaul
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkina Faso‘s military government has announced a comprehensive overhaul of its history, geography, and civic education curricula. The government said the changes are intended to “decolonise” what students are taught as the new school year begins. Higher Education Minister Moumouni Zoungrana said the reform was carried out at the instruction of the prime minister and aimed to correct content inherited from the colonial period.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso: here is the method used to de-radicalize young people
Burkina Faso.summary: A "civic and citizen training" provided in a military camp: this is the method used by the Burkinabe authorities to bring young Sunni worshippers back into the republican fold. After four months of supervision combining military discipline and teaching civic values, a hundred supporters of the preacher Mohamad Ishaq Kindo reunited with their families on Sunday, October 4, 2026 .

Burkina Faso.title: Maternal mortality, nutrition, HPV: when professional advocacy starts to change practices
Burkina Faso.summary: Maternal mortality, nutrition, HPV: when professional advocacy begins to change Carbetocin practices against postpartum hemorrhage in Burkina Faso, micronutrients and midwifery recruitment in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), papillomavirus vaccination in Senegal . For almost four years, the advocacy of six associations of health professionals has started to produce concrete changes in these three countries.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina: the national gendarmerie in search of Boureima Sanfo
Burkina Faso.summary: The Burkinabe national gendarmerie is looking for Boureima Sanfo, a 51-year-old trader in Hamelé in the province of Ioba, in the southwestern part of Burkina Faso, for acts of "breach of trust", according to a notice launched on Wednesday, October 7, 2026. The trader Boureima Sanfo is wanted by the national gendarmerie for "breach of trust relating to the sum of more than 40,000,000 CFA francs" .

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso
Burkina Faso.summary: Human rights violations and abuses against civilians continued during the armed conflict. Military authorities continued their crackdown on the rights to freedom of expression, association and press freedom, through the arrest of journalists, the suspension of media, enforced disappearances and suspensions of NGOs. Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso Opens First Gold Refinery
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkina Faso has opened its first gold refinery as the West African country seeks to strengthen state control over the commercialisation of its mineral resources and reduce gold smuggling. The country is Africa’s third-largest gold producer, producing more than 94 tonnes of the precious metal in 2025, according to the World Gold Council. Authorities have struggled to regulate informal gold mining, a sector affected by smuggling and jihadist violence.

Niger.title: Kidnapped child in Yaounde: the suspect arrested in Tahoua
Niger.summary: On the run after the abduction of a minor in Yaoundé, a woman, presented as the main suspect, was arrested on 5 October 2026 in Tahoua, Niger, following an operation conducted jointly by the Cameroonian and Nigerien security forces. The girl was found safe and sound. The fugitive will finally have ended in Tahoua .

According to the document, this reinforcement follows "intense air-land neutralization operations" carried out against a coalition of terrorist groups .

Mali.title: Operation DOUGOUKOLOKO: The FAMa and their Russian partners intensify the offensive in the Eastern and Central theaters
Mali.summary: In line with its previous communiqué, the General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the national opinion that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their Russian partners, are continuing the large-scale offensive launched on Tuesday, October 6, 2026 in the Eastern Theater, as part of Operation DOUGOUKOLOKO . This operation aims in particular to strengthen the security of the populations living in this part of the national territory, to guarantee the free movement of people and goods, to secure the borders and to stop the criminal economy developed by the armed terrorist groups (GAT) .

Mali.summary: In Aguelhoc, in the Kidal region, the food situation remains a concern for displaced people and host families. Nearly 8,000 people, or about 1,500 households, benefited from this first phase .

Mali.title: Tuareg rebels withdraw from strategic town of Kidal in northern Mali

Mali.title: Aguelhoc: nearly 8,000 displaced people and host families benefit from WFP food stamps
Mali.summary: In Aguelhoc, in the Kidal region, the food situation remains a concern for displaced people and host families. Nearly 8,000 people, or about 1,500 households, benefited from this first phase .

Mali.title: Mali: the army is increasing pressure on Kidal with large-scale military maneuvers supported by airstrikes in the area

Mali.title: Malian army enters strategic northern city of Kidal

A military convoy left the town of Anefis earlier in the day and “entered Kidal shortly before 1:00 pm,” one officer said.

The Commander of the Territorial Gendarmerie Brigade of Kéniéba , Falaye Fodé Keïta and his men grappled with a person from the commune of Faléa, in the circle of Kéniéba, working in the field of money laundering and trafficking in art objects .

Mali.title: Kidal: the Malian army regains control of the city

Mali.summary: In the theater of military operations in the north of Mali, the momentum is accelerating and the pressure is not falling back.

Mali.title: AES: how jihadists learned to strike with drones
Mali.summary: JNIM, a jihadist group linked to Al-Qaeda, claimed responsibility for an ambush on 28 September 2026 against a convoy of the Malian army and the Russian Africa Corps, near Niono, in central Mali. Drone fire opened the attack before the ground assault, and at least four Russians were killed according to local sources . This is clearly an evolution that the armies of the Confederation of Sahel States (AES), which brings together Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger, have not been able to stop: in three years, armed groups in the region have gone from simple reconnaissance drones to strike weapons.

Mali.title: Mali's military offensive has begun in the Kidal region
Mali.summary: Malian social networks favorable to the regime relayed Monday images, filmed the same day, of drone strikes on the city of Tinzawaten, on the Algerian border. These strikes herald the start of the offensive to recapture Kidal and the northern region that was announced for the end of the rainy season . Tinzawaten was until now a military sanctuary of the Azawad Liberation Front, the main target of the offensive to reconquer the north.

Mali.title: Mali: the army recaptures the strategic city of Kidal, deserted by the Bamako rebels (AFP)
Mali.summary: The Malian army, supported by Russian Africa Corps paramilitaries, regained control on Tuesday of the strategic town of Kidal, deserted by Tuareg rebels who have made a "strategic withdrawal" . Burkina Faso.title: Burkina: decrease in road accidents in August and September
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkina Faso recorded a decline in traffic accidents, injuries and fatalities in August and September 2026, with the lowest monthly levels of the year, according to Ministry of Security statistics released Monday. In September, 1,450 accidents were recorded, resulting in 1,055 injuries and 69 deaths, compared to 1,516 accidents, 1,347 injuries and 79 deaths in August In the first nine months of 2026, the country recorded 15,853 traffic accidents, resulting in 12,858 injuries and 910 deaths, the ministry said.

Niger.title: Algeria: President Tebboune discusses relations with Niger and Mali
Niger.summary: Members of the Alliance of Sahel States (AES), Niger and Mali have warmed up their relations with Algeria after the Tinzaouatène incident in April 2025. Niamey leads several projects with Algiers in areas such as mining, energy, etc. In his periodic interview broadcast on Saturday, October 3 on Algerian television channels, President Abdelmadjid Tebboune said that his country supports the development of Niger.

Niger.title: Article reserved for subscribers Analysis. In the Sahel, Algeria has emerged from its doctrine of non-intervention Middle East Eye
Niger.summary: At the request of the Nigerien authorities, Algeria announced, on August 30, the deployment of four Su-30 fighters, a tanker plane and a transport plane to help its neighbor. This support mission was launched in the aftermath of an abortive coup in Niger, a country led by General Abdourahamane Tiani since his own coup in July 2023. The country, which shares a 950-kilometre border with southern Algeria, is shaken by renewed tensions.

Mali.summary: This exhibition, which takes place in two phases, began with an exhibition at the Bamako Exhibition Park and continues with practical demonstrations at the Boubacar Sada Sy Center in Koulikoro. It offers a unique opportunity to discover state-of-the-art equipment, presented by more than 30 international companies, mainly Turkish, but also Russian and Chinese .

Mali.title: FAMa: positions of armed groups targeted in Abéïbara and near Sévaré
Mali.summary: AT THIS MOMENT The Malian army continues its air operations against the armed groups active in the country. In a statement issued Wednesday, August 26, the General Staff of the Armed Forces reported a series of strikes in the north and center of Mali, as part of Operation Dougoukoloko According to the military hierarchy, the exploitation of precise intelligence made it possible, on Monday, August 24, to locate several regroupment points of armed terrorist groups in Abéïbara, in the Kidal region.

Mali.title: 65th anniversary of the Malian Army: the nation pays tribute to its forces
Mali.summary: Mali commemorated this Tuesday the 65th anniversary of the creation of its national army, on the occasion of an official ceremony presided over by the President of the Transition, Army General Assimi Goïta, Supreme Chief of the Armed Forces .

Mali.title: In Mali, from the Wagner Group to Africa Corps, the continuity of impunity?
Mali.summary: The transfer of Wagner's mercenaries to the military of Africa Corps, two Russian organizations, did not put an end to the abuses against civilians.

Mali.title: Senou: A dangerous network of inoperable motorcycle robbers
Mali.summary: FIGHT AGAINST DELINQUENCY and CRIME: As part of the strengthening of security, the Senou Police Station, headed by Chief Police Commissioner Cheickna SOW, arrested three (03) individuals suspected of being members of a criminal network on 19 September 2026 The operation, carried out by the Research Brigade, follows the denunciation of several cases of motorcycle theft in the peripheral districts of Bamako and the surrounding localities, sometimes followed by robberies.

Mali.title: Mali: Evidence of War Crimes
Mali.summary: Members of Mali’s armed forces working together with personnel from the Wagner Group committed war crimes, including the murder and torture of civilians, during joint operations between 2023 and 2025, Amnesty International said in a new report.

Mali.title: Mali: Report Accuses Army and Wagner of War Crimes
Mali.summary: - Civilians killed in joint military operations - Civilians tortured to death in detention; others beaten, simulated drowning and electrocuted - Fulani, Arabs and Tuaregs targeted Members of the Malian armed forces acting with members of the Wagner group committed war crimes, including killings and torture of civilians during operations carried out between 2023 and 2025, Amnesty International said in a new report.

Mali.summary: Sacré-Coeur 3 – BP 15177 CP 10700 Dakar Fann – SENEGAL. +221 33 827 34 91 / +221 77 637 73 15 contact@timbuktu-institute.org Timbuktu Institute - Week 3 September 2026 Niger faced one of its first internal challenges since the arrival of General Abdourahamane Tiani in power in 2023 with the coup attempt at the end of August 2026 . With the support of Africa Corps, the Nigerien army managed to regain control of strategic sites very quickly.

Mali.title: Crash of the Air Algérie flight AH5017 in Mali, the judgment expected in Paris
Mali.summary: Twelve years after the crash of Air Algérie flight AH5017, judgment is expected on Monday, September 28, 2026 in Paris. The aircraft, operated by the Spanish company Swiftair and chartered by Air Algérie, crashed on 24 July 2014 near Gossi, in the Timbuktu region. All 116 people on board, including a Malian, had perished.

Burkina Faso.title: Government exhibition: the achievements of the Ministry of Security presented
Burkina Faso.summary: The Minister of Security, Mahamoudou Sana, took stock of his department on Friday, October 2, 2026, in Ouagadougou, as part of the government exhibition. The Minister of Security, Mahamoudou Sana, lent himself to the accountability exercise, initiated as part of the government exhibition. The dialogue with the people took the form of a mini-conference .

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso: the Patriotic Support Fund exceeds 250 billion FCFA
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkina Faso's Patriotic Support Fund (FSP) has mobilized more than 250 billion CFA francs since January, according to the Government Information Service. This amount exceeds the annual target of 200 billion CFA francs by 25% and shows an increase of 75% compared to the same period in 2025 . Prime Minister Rimtalba Jean Emmanuel Ouédraogo called for continued resource mobilization while strengthening transparency in their management.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso.
Burkina Faso.summary: April 07, 2023 Salafi-Jihadi Movement Weekly Update, April 5, 2023 Data Cutoff: April 5, 2023, at 10 a.m. Contributor: Will Harvey Key Takeaways: Iraq and Syria. The Iraqi Kurdish Peshmerga and Iraqi Security Forces (ISF) will likely remain unable to address coordination issues on the line of control between Iraqi Kurdistan and federal Iraq, likely enabling ISIS to continue its low-grade insurgency in Iraq’s disputed internal boundaries (DIB).

Burkina Faso.title: ECOWAS – ESA: Cooperating against terrorism
Burkina Faso.summary: Meeting on 19 July 2026 in Lungi, Sierra Leone, ECOWAS decided to deepen the dialogue with the Alliance of Sahel States with a view to a security cooperation mechanism. An orientation to reconnect regional efforts against a cross-border threat. On the ground, armed groups cross borders and use regional networks to source weapons, motorcycles, fuel or drones .

Burkina Faso.title: 6 Burkina Faso: Night of the People's Progressive Revolution - The main achievements presented to the population
Burkina Faso.summary: The Night of the People's Progressive Revolution (RPP) was an opportunity to present the main achievements made during the four years of Captain Ibrahim Traoré. From the reconquest of the territory to diplomacy, via agriculture, health and culture, everything demonstrates that Burkina Faso is resolutely committed to its sovereignty and development . In addition to the tribute to the Defence and Security Forces (FDS) and the Volunteers for the Defence of the Fatherland (VDP), the first edition of the night of the People's Progressive Revolution (RPP) was a real moment of accountability.

Burkina Faso.title: 29 September 2026 - 14:21 Ouagadougou: a cannabis trafficking network dismantled, 86 kg seized
Burkina Faso.summary: The Anti-Drug Unit of the Judicial Police Directorate has put an end to the activities of a cannabis trafficking and sales network in Ouagadougou. This structured group also engaged in the sale of adulterated beverages, contraband cigarettes and psychotropic products. According to the police, the goods were transported from a neighboring country, by public or personal transport vehicles .

Niger.title: Defence and Security: SDF adapts to new threats, gains victories and anticipates challenges on the ground
Niger.summary: Terrorist armed groups, employing mercenaries, with an imperialist agenda of destabilization, losing their bearings, are trying everything for the sake of it. Suicidal shrapnel shattered, such as attempts to attack air bases 101 and 401, and the terminal of Diori Hamani airport, in Niamey and Tahoua, the use of improvised explosive devices (IEDs) and kamikaze drones, they face a proven professionalism of the Nigerien Defence and Security Forces (FDS), after decisive strategic and tactical reforms.

Niger.title: Events in Niamey: Algerian military aircraft dispatched to Niger to counter an attempted coup, assures the Algerian President
Niger.summary: In his last periodic interview broadcast Saturday evening on the national channels, the Algerian president returned to the decision of Algiers to send military aircraft to Niger, following the events of Niamey, from 28 to 29 August According to Abdelmadjid Tebboune, the four (04) Su-30 fighters were deployed to the main air base of the Nigerien army, on the outskirts of the capital, to face a coup attempt "The coup attempt in Niger took place the day after the visit of the Prime Minister of Niger to Algeria, which we consider an attempt to provoke us," explained the Algerian head of state, who assured that "some…

Niger.title: Niger: the mutiny that targeted the heart of power
Niger.summary: RIGHT NOW The events of August 29th go far beyond a barracks protest. They establish an armed mutiny directed against several strategic sites, but the public elements do not yet allow to reconstitute an organized project of seizure of power Three days after the shots that shook Niamey, the Nigerien authorities are once again in control of Air Base 101, Diori-Hamani International Airport, the presidential palace and the other targeted sites.

Niger.title: Agadez: the Regional Security Council examines the security situation and recommends strengthening the existing system
Niger.summary: The Governor of the Region of Agadez, Major General Ibra Boulama Issa, chaired, on Wednesday, March 11, 2026, the regular meeting of the Regional Security Council (CRS), held in the usual meeting room in the Governorate of Agadez . This meeting allowed the members of this forum to examine the security situation in the region and identify the measures necessary to strengthen the protection of populations and their property.

Niger.title: Agadez: Seizure of a significant amount of cocaine estimated at more than 2.5 billion CFA francs
Niger.summary: Agadez, Sept 29 (ANP) – The defense and security forces have successfully seized a significant amount of cocaine in the Agadez region. With an estimated value of 2,570,610,000 CFA francs, this seizure was presented to the press on Tuesday, September 29, 2026 at the Regional Directorate of the National Police .

Niger.title: Agadez: more than 50 kg of cocaine and other narcotics seized in Arlit
Niger.summary: The National Gendarmerie intercepted more than 50 kilograms of cocaine as well as other narcotic products during a security operation conducted in the department of Arlit. The market value of the seized drug is estimated at more than two billion CFA francs. The products were handed over to the regional branch of the Central Office for the Suppression of Illicit Drug Trafficking (OCRTIS) in Agadez .

Niger.title: Agadez: Ordinary meeting of the Regional Security Council (CRS)
Niger.summary: Agadez, Sept. 24 (ANP) – The Governor of the Region of Agadez, Major General Ibra Boulama Issa chaired, on Thursday, September 24, 2026, an ordinary meeting of the Regional Security Council (CRS). Several items were on the agenda of this meeting, including the assessment of the security situation in the region .

Niger.title: Pregabalin trafficking in Agadez: Two individuals arrested, 6,900 capsules seized by OCRTIS
Niger.summary: On 22 September 2026, the regional branch of the Central Office for the Suppression of Illicit Drug Trafficking (OCRTIS) in Agadez arrested two individuals suspected of being involved in pregabalin trafficking. The operation resulted in the seizure of 6,900 capsules of this highly risky substance, discovered in the hands of the first suspect and at the home of the second .

significant_events.summary: Bamako, October 04 (AMAP) The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, targeted and struck, on Saturday, October 3, 2026, several entrenchment points of armed terrorist groups, located about 40 kilometers south of Koutiala, says a statement from the General Staff of the Armed Forces . According to the same source, the exploitation of precise intelligence has made it possible to locate several positions housing armed terrorist groups as well as war materials, including many armed vehicles.
sources: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)

significant_events.title: Mali: towards a major FAMa offensive in Kidal against the Fla and JNIM
significant_events.summary: Major troop movements and a series of strikes around Kidal revive questions about the intentions of the Malian Armed Forces in the north of the country. A new operation against the Fla and JNIM positions could emerge, even if the army has not yet announced any reconquest offensive . More than 200 vehicles arrived Saturday in Anéfis, Kidal region, while another convoy of about 80 vehicles reached Aguelhoc on Sunday.

Mali.title: Counter-terrorism: IATTC and DIRPA train journalists to deconstruct extremist narratives
Mali.summary: The Islamic Military Coalition to Combat Terrorism (IMCTC), in collaboration with the Directorate of Information and Public Relations of the Armed Forces (DIRPA), closed this Friday, October 2, 2026, a training session devoted to the analysis of extremist and hate speech in digital media . From September 28 to October 2, 2026, media professionals as well as members of the Defense and Security Forces (FDS) took part in this session organized around the theme: “Analysis of Extremist Speech and Hate Speech in Digital Media: Tools and Techniques for Intelligent Confrontation” .

Mali.title: Fight against terrorism: Captain (Navy) Ibrahima Sow invites the media to collaborate more with DIRPA
Mali.summary: The Director of the Directorate of Information and Public Relations of the Armed Forces (DIRPA), Captain (Navy) Ibrahima Sow, recalled the role of the media in the prevention of hate speech and violent extremism, on the occasion of the closing of the training organized by the Islamic Military Coalition to Combat Terrorism (IMCT) . According to the Director of DIRPA, the IMCT is an alliance of 43 states with a common Muslim religion, which are committed to organizing against terrorism and violent extremism in their regions .

Mali.title: Supply: A convoy of 643 tanker trucks arrives in Bamako under military escort
Mali.summary: A large convoy of more than 643 tanker trucks entered the Malian capital this Saturday, October 3, 2026, at around 7 a.m., after a night escort provided by the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) . The convoy advanced all night under the protection of the military, kilometer after kilometer, before reaching Bamako at dawn. This operation is part of the continuous strengthening of the supply of petroleum products on the national territory .

Mali.title: Mali: Arrival in Bamako of an exceptional convoy of more than 643 tankers under military escort
Mali.summary: While Bamako slept, a long column of tankers advanced into the night, under the watchful protection of our valiant Malian Armed Forces (FAMa). Kilometre after kilometre, our soldiers watched over each vehicle. This Saturday, October 3, 2026, around 7 a.m., at daybreak, more than 643 tankers entered the capital.

Mali.title: Mali: more than 2,400 schools remain closed as insecurity disrupts new school year
Mali.summary: Mali's new school year began Thursday with more than 2,400 schools unable to reopen, as worsening insecurity and the growing presence of jihadist groups continue to disrupt education. The 2026-2027 academic year has been declared the “Year of Education and Culture” by President Assimi Goïta, but thousands of children are starting the year without access to their classrooms.

Burkina Faso.title: Government exhibition The minister in charge of war, Célestin Simporé, exchanges with citizens
Burkina Faso.summary: The Minister of State, Minister of War and Patriotic Defence, Major General Célestin Simporé, moderated the first session of the "Dialogue with the People" on the theme "Governance, National Security: The Standing People Account to You", Friday, October 2, 2026, at the SIAO . The Minister of War and Patriotic Defence, Major General Célestin Simporé lent himself to an exercise of government accountability to the people on Friday, October 2, 2026 at the SIAO .

Burkina Faso.title: Gourma/Security: 600 national VDPs complete their training to strengthen the security of the region - 'Agence d 'Information du Burkina (AIB)
Burkina Faso.summary: Gourma/Security: 600 national VDPs complete their training to strengthen the security of the region 'Burkina Information Agency (AIB)

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso's military leaders mark four years in power
Burkina Faso.summary: People gathered in Ougadougou’s Place de la Révolution on Wednesday night to mark four years since Captain Ibrahim Traoré came to power in a coup. The culmination of anniversary celebrations, they paid tribute to the armed forces and the military government’s achievements in Burkina Faso. One resident, Abdoul Rasmané Sawadogo, said military leaders have created an “ultra-modern army that meets expectations”.

Burkina Faso.title: Pix of the Day, 30 September, 2026 - Across the world
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkina Faso has inaugurated its first gold refinery as its military-led government seeks to strengthen economic sovereignty after breaking ties with its traditional Western partners. “From now on, Burkina Faso’s gold must not only be mined in Burkina Faso; it must also be processed, controlled, valued and certified there,” President Ibrahim Traoré said on Monday at the inauguration of the refinery, named Raffinor-BF.

Burkina Faso.title: Crash of the Ouagadougou-Alger flight: Swiftair condemned
Burkina Faso.summary: The families of the victims had to wait twelve years. Gathered within the association "AH-5017 Ensemble", they led a "relentless fight for truth and justice" which is now experiencing its judicial outcome. The Spanish company Swiftair is found guilty of manslaughter this Monday morning by the Paris Criminal Court .

Niger.title: Algeria sent fighter jets to Niger to thwart ‘coup attempt’, president says
Niger.summary: Algeria’s President Abdelmadjid Tebboune has said that his country sent fighter jets to Niger in late August to help thwart a “coup attempt” that shook the capital, Niamey. The confirmation came in excerpts from Tebboune’s interview with local media outlets that was broadcast on Saturday ahead of its full release.

Niger.title: Algeria's president reveals behind the scenes of sending fighter jets to thwart coup attempt in Niger
Niger.summary: Algerian President Abdelmadjid Tebboune revealed that his country sent fighter jets to Niger at the end of last August to thwart a coup attempt, stressing that his country's military move came in response to "provocations" to Algeria. In excerpts from an interview Tebboune gave to local media, the Algerian president explained that his Nigerian counterpart Mohamed Lamine Zine was on a visit to the country, and returned at night to his country, before a coup attempt took place.

Niger.title: Coup in Niger: Algeria denounces a "provocation" and reveals its military intervention
Niger.summary: Coup d 'état in Niger: Algeria denounces a "provocation" and reveals its military intervention The Algerian President, Abdelmadjid Tebboune, strongly reaffirmed his country's unconditional support for Niger. During his regular meeting with the national press, the Head of State unveiled unprecedented details on Algiers' reaction to the recent coup attempt, described as an act of major destabilization .

Niger.title: Niger: several soldiers fallen at the front and dozens of "mercenaries" neutralized in a new terrorist attack towards Abala
Niger.summary: Several Nigerien soldiers fell on the battlefield and others were wounded in a new terrorist attack on Wednesday, September 23, 2026, in the Fartal area, located 22 km east of Abala, in the Tillabéri region, announced the Minister of National Defence in a statement issued in the evening According to the same source, violent clashes took place between Nigerien soldiers, in an operation to intercept a convoy of cattle stolen the day before in the area, and a large column of "motorcycle mercenaries" and "heavily armed" .

Niger.summary: Defense: General Tiani reshuffles the military command after the Niamey mutiny Published on Saturday, September 12, 2026 | actuniger.com Two weeks to the day after the Niamey mutiny, the President of the Republic and Supreme Chief of the Armed Forces, General Abdourahamane Tiani, Supreme Chief of the Armed Forces, reshuffled the head of the Niger army on Friday, September 11, 2026 According to a statement from the Ministry of National Defence read in the evening on public television, the post of Chief of the Armed Forces Staff (CEMA), Major General Moussa Salaou Barmou, a member of the CNSP and in office since…

Niger.title: Niger: 16 soldiers killed at the front and 15 terrorists neutralized in a terrorist ambush between Bankilaré and Tera (Tillabéri)

The Islamic Military Coalition to Combat Terrorism (IMCTC), in collaboration with the Directorate of Information and Public Relations of the Armed Forces (DIRPA), closed this Friday, October 2, 2026, a training session devoted to the analysis of extremist and hate speech in digital media . According to the Director of DIRPA, the IMCT is an alliance of 43 states with a common Muslim religion, which are committed to organizing against terrorism and violent extremism in their regions . 3. Supply: A convoy of 643 tanker trucks arrives in Bamako under military escort. A large convoy of more than 643 tanker trucks entered the Malian capital this Saturday, October 3, 2026, at around 7 a.m., after a night escort provided by the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) . The convoy advanced all night under the protection of the military, kilometer after kilometer, before reaching Bamako at dawn. This operation is part of the continuous strengthening of the supply of petroleum products on the national territory .

Burkina Faso: 5 retained reports. 1. Government exhibition The minister in charge of war, Célestin Simporé, exchanges with citizens. The Minister of State, Minister of War and Patriotic Defence, Major General Célestin Simporé, moderated the first session of the "Dialogue with the People" on the theme "Governance, National Security: The Standing People Account to You", Friday, October 2, 2026, at the SIAO . The Minister of War and Patriotic Defence, Major General Célestin Simporé lent himself to an exercise of government accountability to the people on Friday, October 2, 2026 at the SIAO . 2. People gathered in Ougadougou’s Place de la Révolution on Wednesday night to mark four years since Captain Ibrahim Traoré came to power in a coup. The culmination of anniversary celebrations, they paid tribute to the armed forces and the military government’s achievements in Burkina Faso. One resident, Abdoul Rasmané Sawadogo, said military leaders have created an “ultra-modern army that meets expectations”.

Niger: 10 retained reports. 1. Algeria sent fighter jets to Niger to thwart ‘coup attempt’, president says. Algeria’s President Abdelmadjid Tebboune has said that his country sent fighter jets to Niger in late August to help thwart a “coup attempt” that shook the capital, Niamey. The confirmation came in excerpts from Tebboune’s interview with local media outlets that was broadcast on Saturday ahead of its full release. 2. Algeria's president reveals behind the scenes of sending fighter jets to thwart coup attempt in Niger. Algerian President Abdelmadjid Tebboune revealed that his country sent fighter jets to Niger at the end of last August to thwart a coup attempt, stressing that his country's military move came in response to "provocations" to Algeria. In excerpts from an interview Tebboune gave to local media, the Algerian president explained that his Nigerian counterpart Mohamed Lamine Zine was on a visit to the country, and returned at night to his country, before a coup attempt took place. 3. Coup in Niger: Algeria denounces a "provocation" and reveals its military intervention. Coup d 'état in Niger: Algeria denounces a "provocation" and reveals its military intervention The Algerian President, Abdelmadjid Tebboune, strongly reaffirmed his country's unconditional support for Niger. During his regular meeting with the national press, the Head of State unveiled unprecedented details on Algiers' reaction to the recent coup attempt, described as an act of major destabilization .

Mali.title: ARMY MUSEUM: the School of Application and Development of Officers to discover the military heritage of our country
Mali.summary: The Army Museum welcomed, this Friday, October 2, 2026, a delegation from the School of Application and Development of Officers (EAPO), as part of the educational activities of the institution. The purpose of this visit was to allow the trainees to learn more about the military history of Mali and to immerse themselves in the immense heritage bequeathed by previous generations of Malian combatants .

Mali.title: Celebration of the 66th anniversary of the Malian Army
Mali.summary: On October 1, 2026, the Malian Army celebrated its 66th anniversary in Djicoroni-Para, under the theme: "The Army, 66 years in the service of the Nation: cohesion and resilience for the sovereign defense of Mali" . Composed in particular of the Infantry, the Artillery and the Armoured Weapon and Cavalry, the Army constitutes the main pillar of the land defence of the country.

Burkina Faso.title: Protection of asins, camels and horses in Burkina Faso: A new framework to better fight against trafficking
Burkina Faso.summary: The Directorate General of Veterinary Services (DGSV) organized, on October 2, 2026 in Ouagadougou, a workshop dedicated to the popularization of the new regulatory framework for asins, camels and horses . Administrative, religious and customary authorities, veterinary services, customs, defence and security forces, VDP and breeders' representatives took part in the meeting to take ownership of the new provisions and strengthen their application on the ground .

Burkina Faso.title: Tribute ceremony to Thomas Sankara: Minister Mathias Traoré invites the Burkinabe to preserve the legacy of the national hero
Burkina Faso.summary: The authorities gathered at the foot of the statue of Thomas Sankara. The Thomas Sankara Memorial hosted, this Thursday, October 1, 2026 in Ouagadougou, the military ceremony in tribute to Captain Thomas Sankara and his twelve companions, who fell on October 15, 1987 The ceremony brought together several members of the government as well as representatives of international organizations, who came to pay tribute to the memory of the former president of Faso and to recall the scope of his legacy.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso opens first gold refinery in push for economic independence
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkina Faso opened its first gold refinery on Monday, pushing ahead with plans to better organise the commercialisation of the precious metal in one of the continent's top producers. The west African nation is the continent's third leading gold producer, churning out more than 94 tonnes of the precious metal last year, according to the World Gold Council. But authorities traditionally struggle to control the informal gold mining sector, which has been blighted by jihadist violence and smuggling.

Niger.summary: The attempted coup in Niamey on the night of 28–29 August 2026 exposed a fundamental contradiction at the heart of General Abdourahamane Tiani’s rule. Mali.summary: The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) are steadfastly pursuing their operations to monitor, control and secure the national territory. As part of Operation Dougoukoloko, the forces involved continue to use available intelligence, reconnaissance and operational capabilities to identify threats and take action against armed terrorist groups . Bamada.net-In a new communication made public by the General Staff of the Armed Forces, several actions carried out on September 30 and October 1, 2026 are reported in different sectors of the country, especially in the vicinity of Tessalit, east of Nampala and north of Sofara .

Mali.title: MALIAN ARMED FORCES: the Army celebrates 66 years in the service of the Nation
Mali.summary: The land component of the Malian Armed Forces, the Army, celebrated the 66th anniversary of its creation on Thursday, October 1, 2026. The event was held on the grounds of the dojo of the 33rd Regiment of Parachute Commandos, in Djicoroni-Para, under the theme: "The Army, 66 years in the service of the Nation: cohesion and resilience for the sovereign defense of Mali" .

Mali.title: PATRIOTIC GESTURE: customs women and wives of customs officers give their blood in favor of the FAMa
Mali.summary: The Association of Women Customs Officers and Wives of Customs Officers (AFDEM) organized, on Thursday, October 1, 2026, a blood donation day for the benefit of the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), in the courtyard of the Malian Customs Office 205 in Faladiè. The ceremony was presided over by the Regional Director of Bamako Customs, Colonel Issiaka TANOU . This initiative recorded the participation of several components of the Defence and Security Forces.

Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: FAMa shelling terrorist hideouts in Tessalit, Nampala and Sofara
Mali.summary: The military command said, via a statement on Thursday, October 1, that the country's security missions are continuing as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, conducted three targeted airstrikes on 30 September and 1 October 2026 . On Wednesday, 30 September, the exploitation of precise intelligence made it possible to locate, in the immediate outskirts of Tessalit, several entrenchment points of armed terrorist groups housing war and logistics equipment.

Mali.title: JOINT PATROL FAMa-MSA-GATIA and AFRICA CORPS: MEMBERS OF the JNIM-FLA COALITION KILLED BETWEEN ANSONGO and MÉNAKA
Mali.summary: Several elements of the JNIM-FLA coalition were neutralized on Monday, September 28, 2026, during an operation led by a patrol of the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners of the Movement for the Salvation of Azawad (MSA), the Tuareg Self-Defense Group Imghad and Allies (GATIA) and the Africa Corps .

Mali.summary: Armed robberies: end of the hunt for three robbers in Sénou On 19 September 2026, the Senou Police Station, headed by Chief Commissioner Cheickna Sow, arrested three individuals suspected of being members of a network specialising in motorcycle theft and robberies on the outskirts of Bamako. . The suspects, S.C., alias "Salfon", 34 years old, O.C., alias "Fah", 25 years old, and A.K., alias "Abdoul", 18 years old, operated mainly at night and targeted homes as well as shops.

Mali.summary: Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger are stepping up their joint media push with Tafouk TV, a new television channel aimed at challenging Western coverage and promoting the three military-led Sahel states' own account of events. Broadcasting from Bamako and available through Canal+, the channel is part of a wider media network being developed by the Alliance of Sahel States - or AES - as its members deepen ties with Russia and distance themselves from France and other Western partners.

Mali.title: Back to School: Displaced Children in Uncertainty
Mali.summary: A few days before the start of the school year, scheduled for 1 October in Mali, displaced families face many obstacles to ensuring the schooling of their children. In Mopti as in Bamako, accommodation difficulties, lack of financial means and uncertainties related to enrolment complicate the resumption of courses . In Mopti, several families who fled the attack on the village of Kouakrou, in the Djenné circle, found refuge in the Djénédaga school.

Mali.title: Terrorist-Tuareg Alliance Leaves Mali’s Junta on Shaky Ground
Mali.summary: Two years after canceling a peace agreement with Tuareg separatists, Mali’s ruling junta is no closer to restoring security to the country, according to analysts. Instead, the junta appears to have undermined its own counterterrorism efforts by prompting the Azawad Liberation Front (FLA) to align with terrorists. “They [the Malian government] decided the factions in the north were terrorists equal to JNIM [Jama’at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin] and would be fought the same way,” Wassim Nasr, senior researcher at The Soufan Center, told ADF.

Burkina Faso.title: Use of motor tricycles: a control operation officially launched
Burkina Faso.summary: The Directorate General of Land and Maritime Transport, in collaboration with the National Road Safety Office and the Municipal Police, officially launched a motor tricycle control operation on Monday, September 28, 2026, in Ouagadougou. From now on, the control of motor tricycles will be permanent to track down infringementists . Mali.title: FUNERAL CEREMONY: the FAMa pay a final tribute to retired Brigadier General Sirakoro SANGARE
Mali.summary: The funeral ceremony of retired Brigadier General Sirakoro SANGARE took place on Tuesday, September 29, 2026, in the place of arms of the 34th Military Engineer Regiment, in the presence of many military, civil, political, administrative and religious authorities, as well as several of his classmates . Born on 22 December 1948 in Bafoulabé, retired Brigadier General Sirakoro SANGARE was the son of Guedjouma and Aminata SAKILIBA.
